reviewer_subject_id: stable reviewer/runtime identifier for the execution being governed
activity: Identity Pass or exact review stage name
target_state_id: environment-provided stable identity for the exact governed artifact state
workload_class: stable workload class used only for externally validated FUSED permission

reasons: Concise evidence-backed semantic explanation for whether one bounded pass is suitable.

notes: SEPARATED is the default. If single_pass_suitable is false, declare at least two bounded subpasses; each subpass records pass_id, scope, isolation_required, and reasons. Set isolation_required when that bounded unit still needs a fresh context. FUSED is permitted only by an exact pre-existing VALIDATED capability permission matching reviewer subject, activity group, and workload_class.
